specs.title: multi-role login and workspace switcher expose only assigned roles
unknown product URLs return not found
registration, email verification, password recovery and login complete end to end

customer security and privacy controls reach their persisted workflows
customer can revoke one device session without ending the current session

cart Remove deletes an entire line at quantity two

customer seller follows persist and seller catalog sorting is applied
seller owner profile edits persist while seller staff remain blocked
super admin logout and user lifecycle work end to end
pending seller owner accounts see an honest onboarding state
super admin can create, edit and archive product listings
marketplace promotions support create, edit, activate, pause, archive and delete
seller listing approval, mock-paid order, fulfilment and return handling work across roles
finance operator reconciles and simulates seller settlement payouts
customer and support agent share a persisted ticket conversation
reported product image and seller dropdown workflows work live
